findings.explanation: Test coverage is incomplete for the acceptance criteria boundaries. Missing: (1) test that bps < 0 raises ValueError (only bps > 10000 tested), (2) test that bps = 0 is allowed (lower boundary of '0..10000 inclusive'), (3) test that cents = 0 is allowed (lower boundary of '>= 0'). These edge cases should be explicitly verified to ensure all constraints in the acceptance criteria are properly tested.
